summary: @servicetitan/eslint-plugin-mobx-6 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13) into the package directory and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bun, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')])` to execute `math_init.js`, a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (Bun-CJS header, string-array rotation with `WV8StW`/`n7gIxM` decoders, hex-named identifiers) and its behavior is not human-readable. The package's declared purpose is a small ESLint plugin for MobX rules (~5KB of TypeScript source in `src/index.ts`) that has no functional need for a second language runtime or a large opaque sibling script. Installing this package on default `npm install` causes an alternate runtime to be fetched and used to execute code whose contents cannot be inspected by tools that only trace Node-resolved code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
